name: Call Center
summary: Phone calls through your own provider account.
description: The existing Call Center integration as a separate app. Configure your own provider and explicitly enable it before handling calls. Provider charges may apply. Getting the app does not buy a number or make a call. Settings, numbers and call history are kept when you remove it. The existing API and agent tools are included; no new call-center screen is added.
permissions: Handles calls only with your configured provider
Keeps its own phone numbers, settings and call history
Provides call tools only to agents you authorize
